behavior: Settings uses an independently scrolling 288px column beside the driver/chat list on laptop screens; narrow screens use a closable overlay.
Driver list retains its height while editing profiles.
List clicks, mouse drag and touch long-hold drag can place chats while Settings remains open. Occupied previews remain visible and lockable.
Full-grid, reserved-slot, save-in-progress and stale profile/grid completion guards remain enforced. Settings-open placement supersedes the previous edit-mode rejection.
acceptance: Actual React browser regression passes at 1366x768, 1536x864 and 1280x720, with at least four whole list rows, click/mouse/touch placement and saving without closing Settings. TypeScript, full-grid, usability and prior drag regressions passed. Mandatory release preflight includes the new regression.
authorization: Mike requested a usable laptop list during profile creation/editing; current workspace policy carries scoped repair through verified Hosting release.
native: No native changes or APK installation required.
